source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
A unit can make an **Assault Disembark Move** only when another rule allows it and all of these are true:

- It is embarked in a **TRANSPORT** model on the battlefield.
- It boarded that **TRANSPORT** before this phase.
- The **TRANSPORT** has not Advanced or Fallen Back this phase.

It is set up using **[Set Up](vsdata:core-rule/set-up)** (03.02), with every model wholly within 3″ of the **TRANSPORT**.

detail.grantedBy: another rule naming this move type

did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
